```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# Normal vs Tumor Baseline Expression — 3-miRNA Signature Components
# TCGA-LUAD & TCGA-LUSC & Pooled (LUAD + LUSC combined)
#
# Signature miRNAs:
#   hsa-miR-509-3p  (Risk factor,   β = +0.743)
#   hsa-miR-377-3p  (Risk factor,   β = +0.503)
#   hsa-miR-378h    (Protective,    β = −0.663)
#
# Pipeline (NO risk score applied):
#   PART 1  — Define signature & precursor mappings
#   PART 2  — Core extraction function: RPM → log2 for tumor (01) & normal (11)
#   PART 3  — Run extraction; build LUAD, LUSC, and Pooled long-format data frames
#   PART 4  — Descriptive statistics (mean, median, SD, zero%)
#   PART 5  — Wilcoxon test (normal vs tumor) per miRNA per cohort + Pooled
#   PART 6  — Colour palette & theme
#   PART 7  — Violin + boxplot per individual cohort (LUAD, LUSC)
#   PART 8  — 6-panel publication figure  (3 miRNAs × 2 cohorts)
#   PART 8B — 3-panel Pooled figure       (3 miRNAs, LUAD+LUSC combined)
#   PART 8C — 9-panel mega figure         (3 miRNAs × 3 cohorts side-by-side)
#   PART 9  — Paired analysis (matched normal-tumor, same patient)
#   PART 10 — Paired dot plots
#   PART 11 — Zero-expression rate summary (platform dropout check)
#   PART 12 — Final output summary
# ==============================================================================

library(survival)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(patchwork)
library(scales)
library(ggpubr)      # for stat_compare_means; install if needed:
                     # install.packages("ggpubr")

# ==============================================================================
# ── USER SETTINGS ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# ==============================================================================

# RDS files produced by the download step in Script_TCGA_all_cohort
RDS_LUAD <- "TCGA_LUAD_miRNA_df.rds"
RDS_LUSC <- "TCGA_LUSC_miRNA_df.rds"

# Output directory
OUT_DIR  <- "Output_NormalVsTumor_3miRNA"

# Minimum samples per group to run stats
MIN_N_GROUP <- 5

# ==============================================================================

dir.create(OUT_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE)
cat("Output directory:", OUT_DIR, "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 1 — Define the 3 signature miRNAs and their precursor mappings
# ==============================================================================

SIG <- data.frame(
  mature_name  = c("hsa-miR-509-3p", "hsa-miR-377-3p", "hsa-miR-378h"),
  log2_col     = c("log2_hsa_miR_509_3p", "log2_hsa_miR_377_3p", "log2_hsa_miR_378h"),
  beta         = c(0.743073677989302, 0.502724385364305, -0.663258691980459),
  direction    = c("Risk (↑ = worse)", "Risk (↑ = worse)", "Protective (↑ = better)"),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Precursor → mature mapping (GDC uses lowercase precursor names)
mature_to_precursor <- list(
  "hsa-miR-509-3p" = c("hsa-mir-509-1", "hsa-mir-509-2", "hsa-mir-509-3"),
  "hsa-miR-377-3p" = c("hsa-mir-377"),
  "hsa-miR-378h"   = c("hsa-mir-378h")
)

# Fallback candidates for hsa-miR-378h if primary absent
fallback_378 <- c("hsa-mir-378a", "hsa-mir-378b", "hsa-mir-378c",
                  "hsa-mir-378d", "hsa-mir-378e", "hsa-mir-378f",
                  "hsa-mir-378g", "hsa-mir-378i")

cat("\n=== 3-miRNA Signature ===\n")
print(SIG[, c("mature_name", "beta", "direction")])

# ==============================================================================
# PART 2 — Core extraction function: RPM → log2 for both tumor & normal
# ==============================================================================
# Sample type codes (positions 14-15 of TCGA barcode):
#   "01" = Primary Solid Tumor
#   "11" = Solid Tissue Normal
#   Other types (02=recurrent, 06=metastatic) are excluded.

extract_normal_tumor <- function(rds_path, cohort_label) {

  cat("\n═══", cohort_label, "═══\n")

  mirna_df <- readRDS(rds_path)
  cat("  RDS loaded:", nrow(mirna_df), "miRNA rows\n")

  # ── Step A: Identify RPM columns ─────────────────────────────────────────
  rpm_cols <- grep("^reads_per_million_miRNA_mapped_TCGA-",
                   colnames(mirna_df), value = TRUE)
  cat("  RPM columns:", length(rpm_cols), "samples\n")

  # Build expression matrix
  expr_rpm           <- as.matrix(mirna_df[, rpm_cols])
  mode(expr_rpm)     <- "numeric"
  rownames(expr_rpm) <- mirna_df$miRNA_ID
  barcodes           <- sub("^reads_per_million_miRNA_mapped_", "", rpm_cols)
  colnames(expr_rpm) <- barcodes

  # ── Step B: Sample type annotation ───────────────────────────────────────
  sample_type_code <- substr(barcodes, 14, 15)
  type_label       <- dplyr::case_when(
    sample_type_code == "01" ~ "Tumor",
    sample_type_code == "11" ~ "Normal",
    TRUE                      ~ "Other"
  )

  cat("  Sample type distribution:\n")
  print(table(type_label))

  # Keep only Tumor (01) and Normal (11)
  keep        <- type_label %in% c("Tumor", "Normal")
  expr_rpm    <- expr_rpm[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  barcodes    <- barcodes[keep]
  type_label  <- type_label[keep]

  # Derive 12-character case IDs (TCGA-XX-XXXX)
  case_ids <- toupper(substr(barcodes, 1, 12))

  cat("  After filtering — Tumor:", sum(type_label == "Tumor"),
      "| Normal:", sum(type_label == "Normal"), "\n")

  # ── Step C: Precursor → mature mapping with 378h fallback ────────────────
  cat("\n  Precursor mapping:\n")
  local_mapping <- mature_to_precursor   # copy to modify locally

  for (mature in names(local_mapping)) {
    prec  <- local_mapping[[mature]]
    found <- prec[prec %in% rownames(expr_rpm)]

    if (length(found) > 0) {
      cat("   ", mature, "→", paste(found, collapse = ", "), "✓\n")
      local_mapping[[mature]] <- found
    } else {
      if (mature == "hsa-miR-378h") {
        avail <- grep("^hsa-mir-378", rownames(expr_rpm), value = TRUE)
        cat("   ⚠  hsa-mir-378h absent. Available 378 precursors:",
            paste(avail, collapse = ", "), "\n")
        fb <- fallback_378[fallback_378 %in% rownames(expr_rpm)]
        if (length(fb) > 0) {
          cat("     Using fallback:", paste(fb, collapse = ", "),
              "— verify biological equivalence.\n")
          local_mapping[[mature]] <- fb
        } else {
          cat("     No 378 precursor found — hsa-miR-378h will be NA.\n")
          local_mapping[[mature]] <- character(0)
        }
      } else {
        avail_top <- head(rownames(expr_rpm), 20)
        cat("   ⚠  No precursor found for", mature, "\n")
        cat("      First 20 miRNA IDs:", paste(avail_top, collapse = ", "), "\n")
        local_mapping[[mature]] <- character(0)
      }
    }
  }

  # ── Step D: Collapse precursors → mature (sum RPM) ───────────────────────
  expr_sig <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(local_mapping), function(mature) {
    prec <- local_mapping[[mature]]
    if (length(prec) == 0) {
      row           <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = 1, ncol = ncol(expr_rpm))
      rownames(row) <- mature
      return(row)
    }
    if (length(prec) == 1) {
      row <- expr_rpm[prec, , drop = FALSE]
    } else {
      row <- matrix(colSums(expr_rpm[prec, , drop = FALSE],
                            na.rm = TRUE), nrow = 1)
    }
    rownames(row) <- mature
    row
  }))

  # ── Step E: log2(RPM + 1) ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  log2_sig <- log2(expr_sig + 1)

  # ── Step F: Build tidy long-format data frame ─────────────────────────────
  result_df <- data.frame(
    case_id     = case_ids,
    barcode     = barcodes,
    tissue_type = type_label,
    cohort      = cohort_label,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )

  for (mature in rownames(log2_sig)) {
    col_name           <- paste0("log2_", gsub("-", "_", mature))
    result_df[[col_name]] <- as.numeric(log2_sig[mature, ])
  }

  # Deduplicate within each tissue type (keep first occurrence per case)
  result_df <- result_df %>%
    group_by(case_id, tissue_type) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup()

  cat("  Final df:", nrow(result_df), "rows\n")
  cat("  Tumor:", sum(result_df$tissue_type == "Tumor"),
      "| Normal:", sum(result_df$tissue_type == "Normal"), "\n")

  result_df
}

# ==============================================================================
# PART 3 — Run extraction for both cohorts & combine
# ==============================================================================

luad_df <- extract_normal_tumor(RDS_LUAD, "TCGA-LUAD")
lusc_df <- extract_normal_tumor(RDS_LUSC, "TCGA-LUSC")

# ── Pooled: combine LUAD + LUSC, tag cohort as "LUAD+LUSC (Pooled)" ──────────
pooled_df <- bind_rows(luad_df, lusc_df) %>%
  mutate(cohort = "LUAD+LUSC (Pooled)")

combined_df <- bind_rows(luad_df, lusc_df, pooled_df) %>%
  mutate(tissue_type = factor(tissue_type, levels = c("Normal", "Tumor")))

cat("\n── Combined dataset (LUAD + LUSC + Pooled) ──\n")
cat("Total rows:", nrow(combined_df), "\n")
print(combined_df %>% count(cohort, tissue_type))

# Long format for plotting
log2_cols_present <- SIG$log2_col[SIG$log2_col %in% colnames(combined_df)]
mirna_missing     <- SIG$mature_name[!SIG$log2_col %in% colnames(combined_df)]
if (length(mirna_missing) > 0)
  cat("  ⚠  miRNAs missing from data:", paste(mirna_missing, collapse = ", "), "\n")

long_df <- combined_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols      = all_of(log2_cols_present),
    names_to  = "log2_col",
    values_to = "log2_expr"
  ) %>%
  left_join(SIG %>% select(log2_col, mature_name, beta, direction),
            by = "log2_col") %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2_expr))

cat("Long-format rows:", nrow(long_df), "\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 4 — Descriptive statistics
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n═══ Descriptive Statistics — log2(RPM+1) ═══\n")

desc_stats <- long_df %>%
  group_by(cohort, mature_name, tissue_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n        = n(),
    mean     = round(mean(log2_expr,   na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    median   = round(median(log2_expr, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    sd       = round(sd(log2_expr,     na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    q25      = round(quantile(log2_expr, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    q75      = round(quantile(log2_expr, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    zero_pct = round(100 * mean(log2_expr == 0, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups  = "drop"
  )

print(desc_stats, n = 50)

write.csv(desc_stats,
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "Descriptive_Stats_NormalVsTumor.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: Descriptive_Stats_NormalVsTumor.csv\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 5 — Wilcoxon rank-sum test (Normal vs Tumor)
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n═══ Wilcoxon Test — Normal vs Tumor ═══\n")

wilcox_results <- long_df %>%
  group_by(cohort, mature_name) %>%
  summarise({
    grp    <- split(log2_expr, tissue_type)
    norm_v <- grp[["Normal"]]
    tum_v  <- grp[["Tumor"]]

    if (length(norm_v) < MIN_N_GROUP || length(tum_v) < MIN_N_GROUP) {
      tibble(
        n_normal = length(norm_v),
        n_tumor  = length(tum_v),
        median_normal = NA_real_,
        median_tumor  = NA_real_,
        W             = NA_real_,
        p_value       = NA_real_,
        p_adj_BH      = NA_real_,
        significance  = "Insufficient n"
      )
    } else {
      wt <- wilcox.test(tum_v, norm_v, exact = FALSE)
      tibble(
        n_normal      = length(norm_v),
        n_tumor       = length(tum_v),
        median_normal = round(median(norm_v, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
        median_tumor  = round(median(tum_v,  na.rm = TRUE), 4),
        W             = round(wt$statistic, 1),
        p_value       = wt$p.value,
        p_adj_BH      = NA_real_,   # filled below
        significance  = ""
      )
    }
  }, .groups = "drop")

# BH correction across all tests
valid_idx            <- !is.na(wilcox_results$p_value)
wilcox_results$p_adj_BH[valid_idx] <- p.adjust(
  wilcox_results$p_value[valid_idx], method = "BH"
)

# Significance labels
wilcox_results <- wilcox_results %>%
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      is.na(p_adj_BH)    ~ "Insufficient n",
      p_adj_BH < 0.001   ~ "***",
      p_adj_BH < 0.01    ~ "**",
      p_adj_BH < 0.05    ~ "*",
      TRUE               ~ "ns"
    ),
    p_value  = formatC(p_value,  digits = 4, format = "g"),
    p_adj_BH = formatC(p_adj_BH, digits = 4, format = "g")
  )

print(wilcox_results, n = 30)

write.csv(wilcox_results,
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "Wilcoxon_NormalVsTumor.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: Wilcoxon_NormalVsTumor.csv\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 6 — Colour palette & theme
# ==============================================================================

COL_NORMAL <- "#2166AC"   # blue  — normal tissue
COL_TUMOR  <- "#B2182B"   # red   — tumor tissue
TISSUE_PAL <- c("Normal" = COL_NORMAL, "Tumor" = COL_TUMOR)

base_theme <- theme_bw(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    plot.title        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 12),
    plot.subtitle     = element_text(size = 9, color = "grey30"),
    strip.background  = element_rect(fill = "grey92", color = "grey60"),
    strip.text        = element_text(face = "bold", size = 10),
    legend.position   = "none",
    panel.grid.minor  = element_blank(),
    axis.title        = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.text         = element_text(size = 9)
  )

# ==============================================================================
# PART 7 — Per-cohort violin + boxplot (one file per cohort)
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n── Part 7: Violin + box plots per cohort ──\n")

for (coh in c("TCGA-LUAD", "TCGA-LUSC", "LUAD+LUSC (Pooled)")) {

  df_coh <- long_df %>% filter(cohort == coh)

  # Get p-value labels for annotation
  wt_coh <- wilcox_results %>%
    filter(cohort == coh) %>%
    select(mature_name, significance, p_adj_BH)

  # Sample counts label per facet
  count_lab <- df_coh %>%
    group_by(mature_name, tissue_type) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(label = paste0(tissue_type, "\nn=", n)) %>%
    group_by(mature_name) %>%
    summarise(count_str = paste(label, collapse = "\n"), .groups = "drop")

  # y-axis max per miRNA for annotation placement
  y_max_df <- df_coh %>%
    group_by(mature_name) %>%
    summarise(y_max = max(log2_expr, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.12, .groups = "drop")

  annot_df <- wt_coh %>%
    left_join(y_max_df, by = "mature_name") %>%
    mutate(
      x       = 1.5,
      label   = paste0("p.adj = ", p_adj_BH, "\n", significance)
    )

  p_vio <- ggplot(df_coh,
                  aes(x = tissue_type, y = log2_expr, fill = tissue_type)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.55, linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.18, outlier.size = 0.8,
                 outlier.alpha = 0.4, linewidth = 0.5,
                 fill = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(data = annot_df,
              aes(x = x, y = y_max, label = label),
              inherit.aes = FALSE,
              size = 3.2, color = "grey20", fontface = "italic",
              hjust = 0.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = TISSUE_PAL) +
    facet_wrap(~ mature_name, scales = "free_y", nrow = 1) +
    labs(
      title    = paste0(coh, " — Baseline miRNA Expression: Normal vs Tumor"),
      subtitle = "log2(RPM + 1)  |  Wilcoxon rank-sum test  |  BH-adjusted p-value",
      x        = "Tissue Type",
      y        = "Expression  [log2(RPM + 1)]"
    ) +
    base_theme

  coh_slug <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", coh)
  out_vio  <- file.path(OUT_DIR, paste0("Violin_NvT_", coh_slug, ".png"))
  png(out_vio, width = 3000, height = 2000, res = 300)
  print(p_vio)
  dev.off()
  cat("  Saved:", out_vio, "\n")
}

# ==============================================================================
# PART 8 — Publication-ready panel: all 3 miRNAs × 2 cohorts (6-panel grid)
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n── Part 8: 6-panel publication plot ──\n")

panel_list <- list()

for (coh in c("TCGA-LUAD", "TCGA-LUSC")) {
  for (mir in SIG$mature_name) {

    df_sub <- long_df %>%
      filter(cohort == coh, mature_name == mir)

    if (nrow(df_sub) < 5) {
      panel_list[[paste(coh, mir)]] <- NULL
      next
    }

    wt_row <- wilcox_results %>%
      filter(cohort == coh, mature_name == mir)

    sig_label <- if (nrow(wt_row) == 0) "" else wt_row$significance[1]
    p_label   <- if (nrow(wt_row) == 0) "" else
      paste0("p.adj=", wt_row$p_adj_BH[1], "  ", sig_label)

    # n labels on x-axis
    n_labs <- df_sub %>%
      group_by(tissue_type) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(x_lab = paste0(tissue_type, "\n(n=", n, ")")) %>%
      deframe()   # named vector: tissue_type → x_lab

    df_sub <- df_sub %>%
      mutate(x_lab = factor(n_labs[as.character(tissue_type)],
                            levels = n_labs[c("Normal", "Tumor")]))

    y_top <- max(df_sub$log2_expr, na.rm = TRUE)

    p_panel <- ggplot(df_sub,
                      aes(x = x_lab, y = log2_expr, fill = tissue_type)) +
      geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.50, linewidth = 0.35) +
      geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.6,
                   outlier.alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.45,
                   fill = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
      annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_top * 1.10,
               label = p_label, size = 2.8,
               color = "grey25", fontface = "italic") +
      scale_fill_manual(values = TISSUE_PAL) +
      labs(
        title    = paste0(coh),
        subtitle = mir,
        x        = NULL,
        y        = "log2(RPM + 1)"
      ) +
      theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
      theme(
        plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
        plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey20",
                                        face = "italic"),
        legend.position  = "none",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        axis.text        = element_text(size = 8)
      )

    panel_list[[paste(coh, mir)]] <- p_panel
  }
}

# Remove NULLs
panel_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), panel_list)

if (length(panel_list) >= 2) {
  panel_combined <- wrap_plots(panel_list, ncol = 3) +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = "Baseline Expression: Normal vs Tumor — 3-miRNA Signature",
      subtitle = "log2(RPM + 1) · Wilcoxon rank-sum · BH-adjusted p-value · TCGA-LUAD & TCGA-LUSC",
      theme    = theme(
        plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey35",  size = 10)
      )
    )

  out_panel <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "Panel_NormalVsTumor_3miRNA_6plots.png")
  png(out_panel, width = 5400, height = 3600, res = 300)
  print(panel_combined)
  dev.off()
  cat("  Saved:", out_panel, "\n")
}

# ==============================================================================
# PART 8B — Pooled (LUAD + LUSC) 3-panel figure
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n── Part 8B: Pooled 3-panel figure (LUAD+LUSC combined) ──\n")

pooled_panel_list <- list()

for (mir in SIG$mature_name) {

  df_sub <- long_df %>%
    filter(cohort == "LUAD+LUSC (Pooled)", mature_name == mir)

  if (nrow(df_sub) < 5) next

  wt_row  <- wilcox_results %>%
    filter(cohort == "LUAD+LUSC (Pooled)", mature_name == mir)
  sig_lbl <- if (nrow(wt_row) == 0) "" else wt_row$significance[1]
  p_lbl   <- if (nrow(wt_row) == 0) "" else
    paste0("p.adj = ", wt_row$p_adj_BH[1], "  ", sig_lbl)

  n_labs <- df_sub %>%
    group_by(tissue_type) %>%
    summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
    mutate(x_lab = paste0(tissue_type, "\n(n=", n, ")")) %>%
    { setNames(.$x_lab, .$tissue_type) }

  df_sub <- df_sub %>%
    mutate(x_lab = factor(n_labs[as.character(tissue_type)],
                          levels = n_labs[c("Normal", "Tumor")]))

  y_top <- max(df_sub$log2_expr, na.rm = TRUE)

  p_pool <- ggplot(df_sub,
                   aes(x = x_lab, y = log2_expr, fill = tissue_type)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.50, linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.6,
                 outlier.alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.45,
                 fill = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_top * 1.10,
             label = p_lbl, size = 2.8,
             color = "grey25", fontface = "italic") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = TISSUE_PAL) +
    labs(
      title    = "LUAD+LUSC (Pooled)",
      subtitle = mir,
      x        = NULL,
      y        = "log2(RPM + 1)"
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 8, color = "grey20", face = "italic"),
      legend.position  = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 8)
    )

  pooled_panel_list[[mir]] <- p_pool
}

pooled_panel_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), pooled_panel_list)

if (length(pooled_panel_list) >= 1) {
  pooled_panel <- wrap_plots(pooled_panel_list, ncol = 3) +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = "Baseline Expression: Normal vs Tumor — 3-miRNA Signature (Pooled LUAD+LUSC)",
      subtitle = "log2(RPM + 1) · Wilcoxon rank-sum · BH-adjusted p-value · TCGA-LUAD + TCGA-LUSC combined",
      theme    = theme(
        plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey35", size = 10)
      )
    )

  out_pool <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "Panel_NormalVsTumor_3miRNA_Pooled.png")
  png(out_pool, width = 5400, height = 2000, res = 300)
  print(pooled_panel)
  dev.off()
  cat("  Saved:", out_pool, "\n")
}

# ==============================================================================
# PART 8C — 9-panel mega figure (3 miRNAs × 3 cohorts: LUAD / LUSC / Pooled)
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n── Part 8C: 9-panel mega figure (3 miRNAs × 3 cohorts) ──\n")

# Build a helper function so we can reuse clean panel code
make_panel_plot <- function(df_sub, title_str, subtitle_str, p_lbl, y_top) {
  ggplot(df_sub,
         aes(x = x_lab, y = log2_expr, fill = tissue_type)) +
    geom_violin(trim = FALSE, alpha = 0.50, linewidth = 0.35) +
    geom_boxplot(width = 0.15, outlier.size = 0.6,
                 outlier.alpha = 0.35, linewidth = 0.45,
                 fill = "white", alpha = 0.85) +
    annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_top * 1.10,
             label = p_lbl, size = 2.6, color = "grey25", fontface = "italic") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = TISSUE_PAL) +
    labs(title = title_str, subtitle = subtitle_str,
         x = NULL, y = "log2(RPM + 1)") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 9) +
    theme(
      plot.title       = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9),
      plot.subtitle    = element_text(size = 7.5, color = "grey20", face = "italic"),
      legend.position  = "none",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      axis.text        = element_text(size = 7.5)
    )
}

# Cohort display order: LUAD | LUSC | Pooled (rows), miRNA (columns)
COHORT_ORDER <- c("TCGA-LUAD", "TCGA-LUSC", "LUAD+LUSC (Pooled)")
mega_list    <- list()

for (mir in SIG$mature_name) {
  for (coh in COHORT_ORDER) {

    df_sub <- long_df %>%
      filter(cohort == coh, mature_name == mir)

    if (nrow(df_sub) < 5) {
      mega_list[[paste(mir, coh)]] <- NULL
      next
    }

    wt_row  <- wilcox_results %>%
      filter(cohort == coh, mature_name == mir)
    sig_lbl <- if (nrow(wt_row) == 0) "" else wt_row$significance[1]
    p_lbl   <- if (nrow(wt_row) == 0) "" else
      paste0("p.adj=", wt_row$p_adj_BH[1], "  ", sig_lbl)

    n_labs <- df_sub %>%
      group_by(tissue_type) %>%
      summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
      mutate(x_lab = paste0(tissue_type, "\n(n=", n, ")")) %>%
      { setNames(.$x_lab, .$tissue_type) }

    df_sub <- df_sub %>%
      mutate(x_lab = factor(n_labs[as.character(tissue_type)],
                            levels = n_labs[c("Normal", "Tumor")]))

    y_top <- max(df_sub$log2_expr, na.rm = TRUE)

    p <- make_panel_plot(df_sub,
                         title_str    = coh,
                         subtitle_str = mir,
                         p_lbl        = p_lbl,
                         y_top        = y_top)

    mega_list[[paste(mir, coh)]] <- p
  }
}

mega_list <- Filter(Negate(is.null), mega_list)

if (length(mega_list) >= 2) {
  # Layout: columns = cohorts (3), rows = miRNAs (3) → ncol = 3
  mega_panel <- wrap_plots(mega_list, ncol = 3) +
    plot_annotation(
      title    = "Baseline miRNA Expression: Normal vs Tumor — 3-miRNA Signature",
      subtitle = paste0("log2(RPM + 1)  ·  Wilcoxon rank-sum  ·  BH-adjusted p-value\n",
                        "Columns: TCGA-LUAD  |  TCGA-LUSC  |  LUAD+LUSC Pooled",
                        "     Rows: hsa-miR-509-3p  |  hsa-miR-377-3p  |  hsa-miR-378h"),
      theme    = theme(
        plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "grey35", size = 9.5)
      )
    )

  out_mega <- file.path(OUT_DIR, "Panel_NormalVsTumor_3miRNA_9plots_AllCohorts.png")
  png(out_mega, width = 5400, height = 5400, res = 300)
  print(mega_panel)
  dev.off()
  cat("  Saved:", out_mega, "\n")
}

# ==============================================================================
# PART 9 — Paired analysis (matched normal-tumor, same patient)
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n── Part 9: Paired analysis (matched cases) ──\n")

paired_stats <- long_df %>%
  group_by(cohort, mature_name) %>%
  summarise({
    pivot_w <- cur_data() %>%
      select(case_id, tissue_type, log2_expr) %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = tissue_type, values_from = log2_expr)

    paired_df <- pivot_w %>%
      filter(!is.na(Normal), !is.na(Tumor))

    if (nrow(paired_df) < MIN_N_GROUP) {
      tibble(
        n_pairs        = nrow(paired_df),
        median_delta   = NA_real_,
        mean_delta     = NA_real_,
        p_paired_wilcox = NA_real_,
        significance   = "Insufficient pairs"
      )
    } else {
      delta <- paired_df$Tumor - paired_df$Normal
      pw    <- wilcox.test(paired_df$Tumor, paired_df$Normal,
                           paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
      tibble(
        n_pairs         = nrow(paired_df),
        median_delta    = round(median(delta), 4),  # Tumor − Normal
        mean_delta      = round(mean(delta),   4),
        p_paired_wilcox = pw$p.value,
        significance    = case_when(
          pw$p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
          pw$p.value < 0.01  ~ "**",
          pw$p.value < 0.05  ~ "*",
          TRUE               ~ "ns"
        )
      )
    }
  }, .groups = "drop")

cat("\n═══ Paired Analysis Summary (Tumor − Normal, same patient) ═══\n")
print(paired_stats, n = 20)

write.csv(paired_stats,
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "Paired_NormalVsTumor.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: Paired_NormalVsTumor.csv\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 10 — Paired dot plot (only cohorts with matched normals)
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n── Part 10: Paired dot plots ──\n")

for (coh in c("TCGA-LUAD", "TCGA-LUSC", "LUAD+LUSC (Pooled)")) {
  for (mir in SIG$mature_name) {

    df_sub <- long_df %>%
      filter(cohort == coh, mature_name == mir) %>%
      select(case_id, tissue_type, log2_expr)

    pivot_w <- df_sub %>%
      pivot_wider(names_from = tissue_type, values_from = log2_expr) %>%
      filter(!is.na(Normal), !is.na(Tumor))

    if (nrow(pivot_w) < MIN_N_GROUP) {
      cat("  [SKIP paired]", coh, mir,
          "— only", nrow(pivot_w), "matched pairs\n")
      next
    }

    cat("  ", coh, mir, "—", nrow(pivot_w), "matched pairs\n")

    pivot_long <- pivot_w %>%
      pivot_longer(c("Normal", "Tumor"),
                   names_to  = "tissue_type",
                   values_to = "log2_expr") %>%
      mutate(tissue_type = factor(tissue_type, levels = c("Normal", "Tumor")))

    pw_p <- wilcox.test(pivot_w$Tumor, pivot_w$Normal,
                        paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)$p.value
    p_lbl <- ifelse(pw_p < 0.001, "p < 0.001",
                    paste0("p = ", formatC(pw_p, digits = 3, format = "g")))

    y_range <- range(pivot_long$log2_expr, na.rm = TRUE)
    y_ann   <- y_range[2] + diff(y_range) * 0.10

    p_paired <- ggplot(pivot_long,
                       aes(x = tissue_type, y = log2_expr,
                           group = case_id)) +
      geom_line(alpha = 0.25, linewidth = 0.3, color = "grey50") +
      geom_point(aes(color = tissue_type), size = 1.4, alpha = 0.65) +
      stat_summary(fun = median, geom = "crossbar",
                   width = 0.35, linewidth = 0.8,
                   aes(group = 1, color = tissue_type), show.legend = FALSE) +
      annotate("text", x = 1.5, y = y_ann,
               label = paste0("Paired Wilcoxon\n", p_lbl,
                               "\nn pairs = ", nrow(pivot_w)),
               size = 3, color = "grey25", fontface = "italic",
               hjust = 0.5) +
      scale_color_manual(values = TISSUE_PAL) +
      labs(
        title    = paste0(coh, " — ", mir),
        subtitle = "Paired normal–tumor (same patient)  |  Median crossbar",
        x        = "Tissue Type",
        y        = "Expression  [log2(RPM + 1)]"
      ) +
      base_theme

    mir_safe <- gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9]", "_", mir)
    coh_safe <- gsub("-", "_", coh)
    out_p    <- file.path(OUT_DIR,
                          paste0("Paired_", coh_safe, "_", mir_safe, ".png"))
    png(out_p, width = 1800, height = 2000, res = 300)
    print(p_paired)
    dev.off()
    cat("    Saved:", out_p, "\n")
  }
}

# ==============================================================================
# PART 11 — Zero-expression rate summary (platform dropout check)
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n── Part 11: Zero-expression rate (platform dropout check) ──\n")

zero_rate <- long_df %>%
  group_by(cohort, mature_name, tissue_type) %>%
  summarise(
    n          = n(),
    n_zero     = sum(log2_expr == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    zero_pct   = round(100 * mean(log2_expr == 0, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    flag       = ifelse(zero_pct >= 80,
                        "⚠ PLATFORM DROPOUT (≥80% zero)", "OK"),
    .groups    = "drop"
  )

cat("\n═══ Zero-Expression Rate Summary ═══\n")
print(zero_rate, n = 30)

write.csv(zero_rate,
          file.path(OUT_DIR, "ZeroRate_NormalVsTumor.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)
cat("✓ Saved: ZeroRate_NormalVsTumor.csv\n")

# ==============================================================================
# PART 12 — Final output summary
# ==============================================================================

cat("\n\n✓ ════════════ ALL DONE ════════════\n")
cat("Output directory:", OUT_DIR, "\n\n")
cat("  Plots:\n")
cat("  Violin_NvT_TCGA_LUAD.png                        — violin+box, LUAD only\n")
cat("  Violin_NvT_TCGA_LUSC.png                        — violin+box, LUSC only\n")
cat("  Violin_NvT_LUAD_LUSC__Pooled_.png               — violin+box, Pooled\n")
cat("  Panel_NormalVsTumor_3miRNA_6plots.png            — 6-panel: 3 miRNAs × LUAD+LUSC\n")
cat("  Panel_NormalVsTumor_3miRNA_Pooled.png            — 3-panel: 3 miRNAs, Pooled only\n")
cat("  Panel_NormalVsTumor_3miRNA_9plots_AllCohorts.png — 9-panel: 3 miRNAs × 3 cohorts\n")
cat("  Paired_<cohort>_<miRNA>.png                      — paired dot plots (matched cases)\n\n")
cat("  CSV outputs:\n")
cat("  Descriptive_Stats_NormalVsTumor.csv   — mean, median, SD, zero% (all cohorts)\n")
cat("  Wilcoxon_NormalVsTumor.csv            — Wilcoxon W, p, p.adj BH (all cohorts)\n")
cat("  Paired_NormalVsTumor.csv              — paired Wilcoxon, delta  (all cohorts)\n")
cat("  ZeroRate_NormalVsTumor.csv            — platform dropout check  (all cohorts)\n")
```
